# Markdown Example Guide

Welcome to this quick example demonstrating various Markdown features.

## 1. Text Formatting

Markdown makes it easy to add emphasis and styling to your text:
* **Bold text** using double asterisks.
* *Italic text* using single asterisks.
* ~~Strikethrough~~ using double tildes.
* `Inline code` using backticks.

## 2. Tables

Here is a simple table organizing some data:

| Feature | Syntax | Result |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Bold | `**text**` | **Bold** |
| Italic | `*text*` | *Italic* |
| Code | `` `code` `` | `code` |

## 3. Links and Images

You can easily embed external resources into your document:

* **Link:** [Markdown Guide](https://www.markdownguide.org)
* **Image:** ![A placeholder landscape image](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1464822759023-fed622ff2c3b?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80)
